ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a dual-functionalization strategy grafting phytic (flame-retardant) and sulfate (fast Li-ion conducting) groups onto cellulose via a ternary deep eutectic solvent. This yields a safe, flexible solid electrolyte with high conductivity (1.48×10⁻³ S cm⁻¹), 5.2 V oxidation stability, self-extinguishing behavior, and long cycling (542/409 cycles), advancing eco-friendly cellulose electrolytes for next-generation Li-metal batteries.

item.title: Entropy-engineered polar heterogeneity enables near-decoupled polarization–strain behavior for high-density energy storage
item.description:
این پژوهش با مهندسی آنتروپی و ایجاد ناهمگنی قطبی، رفتار قطبی‌شدن-کرنش تقریباً جدا شده را برای ذخیره‌سازی انرژی با چگالی بالا ممکن می‌سازد.
Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Entropy is introduced as a quantitative design parameter to engineer polar heterogeneity in lead-free relaxor ferroelectrics, disrupting long-range polar coherence and decoupling polarization from strain. This yields an ultralow electrostrictive coefficient and 21.5 J cm⁻³ energy density with minimal electrostrain, establishing configurational entropy as a descriptor for weak electromechanical coupling in high-density dielectric capacitors.
🏷 entropy engineering · polar heterogeneity · energy storage · polarization-strain decoupling · dielectric capacitor
